top_ideas.title: Offline-first local repository dashboard
top_ideas.description: Use the local git CLI to manage many repositories without introducing GitHub API auth or cloud dependencies.
key_strengths: No network dependency beyond git remotes
Works with any local GitHub clone
main_challenges: Need background execution to avoid freezing the UI
next_steps: Create repository discovery and persistence services

recommendations.primary: Implement a Python + Tkinter MVP with a repository table, batch actions, and a git graph viewer.
alternatives: Later migrate to a richer desktop shell if the product needs advanced visuals or plugins.

follow_up.summary: Create a greenfield desktop MVP with testable services and a single-window workflow.
